data.title: 芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 墓地回忆】白色野花盛开的静谧墓园里，古旧的石十字架在清晨薄雾中静默伫立。芙莉莲在勇者的墓碑前驻足，指尖轻轻抚过冰冷的石面，绿色眼眸里流露追思。她想起旅途中新找到的魔法，也想起尚未说完的话。
data.action: 站在勇者墓碑前，以指尖轻触石面，安静追思
data.promptProse: She rests her fingertips on Himmel's memorial while her other hand holds her cloak edge. Soft morning light reaches the weathered stone through mist above the white wildflowers.
data.animaCaption: One hand rests on Himmel's memorial while the other holds her cloak.
